attr.title: Das Erbe 2
attr.desc: A C#/.NET reimplementation of Das Schmutzige Erbe (Das Erbe 2), the German environmental-advertising point-and-click adventure sequel to Das Erbe, built on raylib.
attr.desc_md: A C#/.NET reimplementation of *Das Schmutzige Erbe* (*Das Erbe 2*), the 1993 sequel to *Das Erbe*. Reverse-engineered from the original Amiga release, recreating its presentation, interaction flow, scene progression, save/load behavior, and TFMX music playback, built on [raylib](https://www.raylib.com/) instead of the original Amiga hardware.
attr.inst: Install via PortMaster and run. The original game files are bundled with the port; Das Erbe 2 was freeware. The bundled pictures, font, music, and samples are original game assets, not covered by this port's GPL license; all rights remain with their respective owners.
